rows.approx: cut variant "open": back rail cut out (walk-through passage); the matrix is exact (same vertices as the base model), the faces of the boxes in cutBoxes must be dropped
cut variant "open": end posts cut out (the road walks over it); the matrix is exact (same vertices as the base model), the faces of the boxes in cutBoxes must be dropped
trim variant: the post is flattened onto the cut plane y = 5.690 m (the optimized model keeps the full post and bar); the matrix is exact for every other vertex
trim variant: the post is flattened onto the cut plane y = 3.370 m (the optimized model keeps the full post and bar); the matrix is exact for every other vertex
warp variant "wide" (splay): a NON-affine bend of the base model; the matrix is the base model's (no re-centre), the bend is not applied
warp variant "slim" (squeeze_z): a NON-affine bend of the base model; the matrix is the base model's (no re-centre), the bend is not applied
